name: orchard-rebuild-v5
description: The Orchard rebuild's ACTION layer, switched off. READ THIS BEFORE READING THE ARM, because it is the same caveat the Wheat arm carries and it is load-bearing: a suit rebuild is a data-and-handler change, not a set of numbers, so NO OVERLAY CAN EXPRESS "the Orchard suit as it was". A knob cannot un-write a threshold that has become a printed action, cannot restore a Farmstead that looked at a third card instead of keeping it, cannot un-turn O16 The Orchard Keeper from paying for going out back to paying for being visited, and cannot put back the once-per-turn cap O17 lost. Against the shipped game this arm therefore isolates the ONE piece of the rebuild an overlay can reach: O13 The Grand Orchard, O14 The Conservatory and O15 The Garden Library, the three Tier 3 cards that print an ACTION taken instead of a main action. Base is the rebuild with them in, this cell is the rebuild with them out, and the delta is what the action layer is worth. Every other pass condition - Tier 3 firings per card built up from 0.63, Orchard's activations per card built up from 0.34, ORCHARDS BUILT PER ORCHARD SEAT (the number the Barn's refund lives or dies on), CARDS GIVEN TO RIVALS PER GAME and BARN CARDS IN BY ROUTE (the number the "rich in cards, poor in freight" claim lives or dies on), reshuffles per played deck flat at 5 to 8, visits per turn at or above 0.57, the bonus-slot mix still at least 70% visit, and above all ORCHARD'S WIN RATE NOT UP from 80.8% - is before-and-after against the committed reference run, not against this cell. And the win rate is not expected to move at all: the measured cause is the Draw Service welded to the suit, no card in this rebuild is the fix, and a flat win rate is the EXPECTED result rather than a failure of the arm. Read the noise floor before believing any of it. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
